_comment: TERRITORY GRID v2 (Spencer-approved 2026-07-22 density plan): far-south 2x/wk (Luke Mon Oly-west + Thu Lacey/Yelm arc; Enumclaw->Tue; Tacoma/Puyallup/Graham belt Wed; Orting/Sumner Fri), far-north 2x/wk (Cory Tue Shoreline + Wed everything-north-of-Kirkland; Mon pure Eastside core). Peninsula stays WEEKLY (biweekly rejected). v1 was 2026-07-11. | v3 (2026-07-23): Cory+Alias ride as ONE CREW (OR driver = Cory Ventura); Spencer keeps ONLY the weekly Tue peninsula run — his Renton/Newcastle->Cammeron Thu, Mercer/Bellevue-S->Crew Thu, North Bend/Snoqualmie/Fall City->Crew Wed. Tavis not currently working — no territory until he returns. | 2026-07-26: peninsula zip fix — 98312 Bremerton (was Luke/wed), 98335 Gig Harbor + 98367 Port Orchard (were tech "(unknown)") -> Spencer/tue. Root cause of the Darren Corliss #7933 Bremerton stop landing on Luke Wed. | jobOverrides added 2026-07-26: JOB-level tech exceptions that beat the zip rule (first entry: 8056 Madera West Condos -> Spencer). NOTE: nothing enforces tech assignment yet — optimize-week runs lockTechs=false, so overrides are advisory until tech-locking is built. | v4 (2026-07-26) DAY-BALANCE: grid v3 forced 149 stops onto Thursday vs ~105 of 4-truck capacity while Mon sat at 60 and Fri at 40. Root cause: 10 zips the crews actually work on FRIDAY (verified in Jobber 7/10, 7/17, 7/24) were assigned thu/tue. With Cammeron blocked Fri and Spencer peninsula-only, Friday drops from 4 trucks to 2 (Luke + Cory), so the I-90 corridor moved to Friday/Cory and Auburn+Bellevue-S+Redmond moved to Monday. Result mon 89 / tue 101 / wed 103 / thu 106 / fri 64 against 105/115/105/105/70. Franks + Norton are RIDE-ALONGS, not extra trucks (Spencer 2026-07-26). | 2026-07-26 walkthrough: Cory mon was 44 stops/10.5h vs thu 29/7.0h -> 98006+98008 (10 stops) moved mon->thu. | v5 (2026-07-26) DAY SPLITS from the live day-by-day review: Luke Tacoma block wed->mon (17 stops), Cammeron Maple Valley thu->wed (18 stops). Rule: when a tech-day is way overfilled, split it across that SAME tech's light day rather than reassigning to another tech. | v6 (2026-07-26): FRIDAY rebuilt — Spencer takes the I-90 Snoqualmie/Fall City run (98045/98024/98065/98027), Cory splits the south belt with Luke (Cory=Buckley 98321, Luke=Bonney Lake/Lake Tapps/Sumner/Orting). 98372 Edgewood consolidated tue->mon. NOTE: Spencer now works TUE peninsula + FRI I-90, not Tuesday only. | v7 (2026-07-26): 98092 Auburn -> tue/Luke (was mon/Cammeron) per Spencer day-review. | v8 (2026-07-26): Luke intra-week balance — South Hill 98373/74/75 wed->fri, Olympia 98502 + Tumwater 98512 mon->thu. Luke was 34.8h across mon-wed vs 13.5h thu-fri. | v9 (2026-07-26): TWO-DAY ZONES introduced — a zip may carry days:[a,b] and push-week --grid sets allowedDates across both plus allowedWeekdays, letting the optimizer split a zip too big for one day. First: 98092 Auburn tue+fri (Luke). | v10 (2026-07-26): 7 job-level overrides onto Cammeron's Monday (#8116,#6567,#4975,#8163,#8086,#7725,#7736) — his Monday was the lightest day in the fleet at 6.8h. | v11 (2026-07-26 eve): 12 job-level overrides from Spencer's second day-review pass. | v12 (2026-07-26 eve): Spencer takes a 16-stop Bellevue-S/Mercer Island/Newcastle block on THURSDAY. Spencer now works tue (peninsula), thu (this block), fri (I-90) — no longer Tuesday-only. | 2026-07-27: Spencer's peninsula run moved tue->wed for the week of 7/27 via jobOverrides (zip rule unchanged). REMOVE those 10 overrides after 7/29.
